reference_semantic_plan.program: SCAN_TABLE(NHTSA, complaints, [complaint_id, make, component_id, summary_text]) -> FILTER(make IN ['KIA','HYUNDAI']) -> SEM_FILTER('summary_text describes fire, smoke, burning smell, melting, or an electrical short related to the vehicle system.', input_bindings={text: summary_text}) -> JOIN(inner, on=[make = r.make AND component_id = r.component_id], right=( SCAN_DOCS(NHTSA, recalls AS r, [campaign.number, vehicle.make AS make, component.component_id AS component_id, risk.park_outside, risk.defect_summary]) -> FILTER(vehicle.make IN ['KIA','HYUNDAI'] AND risk.park_outside='TRUE') -> DEDUP([campaign.number]) )) -> GROUP_BY([r.campaign.number, r.make, r.component_id], aggs={matched_complaint_count: count_distinct(complaint_id), defect_summary: any(risk.defect_summary)}) -> PROJECT([campaign_number: r.campaign.number, make: r.make, component_id: r.component_id, matched_complaint_count, defect_summary])

complaints := (
  SCAN_TABLE(NHTSA, complaints, [complaint_id,vehicle_id,component_id,received_date,summary_text])
  -> FILTER(received_date IS NOT NULL AND received_date <> '')
)
recalls := (
  SCAN_DOCS(NHTSA, recalls, [recall_id,campaign.number,vehicle.vehicle_id AS vehicle_id,component.component_id AS component_id,campaign.report_received_date,risk.defect_summary])
  -> FILTER(campaign.report_received_date IS NOT NULL AND campaign.report_received_date <> '')
)
matched_pairs := SEM_JOIN(left=complaints, right=recalls, instruction="Evaluate only pairs with the same vehicle_id and component_id where the recall report date is at least 90 days after the complaint date. Keep a pair only when the complaint summary and recall defect summary describe the same concrete underlying defect mechanism, not merely the same broad component or symptom.", input_bindings_left={complaint_id,vehicle_id,component_id,received_date,summary_text}, input_bindings_right={recall_id,campaign.number,vehicle_id,component_id,report_received_date,defect_summary})
matched_pairs
-> GROUP_BY([], {matched_pair_count:COUNT_DISTINCT(left.complaint_id,right.recall_id)})

dodge_airbag_complaints := (
  SCAN_TABLE(NHTSA, complaints, [complaint_id,make,component_id,summary_text])
  -> FILTER(make = 'DODGE' AND component_id = 'AIRBAG')
)
dodge_airbag_recalls := (
  SCAN_DOCS(NHTSA, recalls, [campaign.number,vehicle.make AS make,component.component_id AS component_id,risk.defect_summary])
  -> FILTER(make = 'DODGE' AND component_id = 'AIRBAG')
  -> DEDUP([campaign.number])
)
matched_pairs := SEM_JOIN(left=dodge_airbag_complaints, right=dodge_airbag_recalls, instruction="Keep a complaint-recall pair only when both texts describe the same concrete airbag failure mechanism or deployment hazard, such as the same non-deployment, unintended deployment, or inflator-rupture problem. A generic shared mention of airbags is insufficient.", input_bindings_left={complaint_id,summary_text}, input_bindings_right={campaign.number,defect_summary})
matched_pairs
-> GROUP_BY([right.campaign.number], {matched_pair_count:COUNT_DISTINCT(left.complaint_id,right.campaign.number)})
-> ORDER_BY([matched_pair_count DESC,right.campaign.number ASC])
-> PROJECT([campaign_number=right.campaign.number,matched_pair_count])

dodge_electrical_complaints := (
  SCAN_TABLE(NHTSA, complaints, [complaint_id,make,component_id,summary_text])
  -> FILTER(make = 'DODGE' AND component_id = 'ELECTRICAL')
)
dodge_electrical_recalls := (
  SCAN_DOCS(NHTSA, recalls, [recall_row_id,campaign.number,vehicle.make AS make,component.component_id AS component_id,risk.defect_summary])
  -> FILTER(make = 'DODGE' AND component_id = 'ELECTRICAL')
)
matched_pairs := SEM_JOIN(left=dodge_electrical_complaints, right=dodge_electrical_recalls, instruction="Keep a pair only when the complaint narrative and recall defect summary describe the same concrete electrical failure and the shared failure has a safety consequence such as stall, fire risk, loss of motive power, loss of lighting or warnings, unintended cruise behavior, or warning-system failure. Broad ELECTRICAL-category overlap is insufficient.", input_bindings_left={complaint_id,summary_text}, input_bindings_right={recall_row_id,campaign.number,defect_summary})
matched_pairs
-> GROUP_BY([right.campaign.number], {matched_pair_count:COUNT_DISTINCT(left.complaint_id,right.recall_row_id)})
-> ORDER_BY([matched_pair_count DESC,right.campaign.number ASC])
-> PROJECT([campaign_number=right.campaign.number,matched_pair_count])

SCAN_TABLE(NHTSA, complaints, [complaint_id, vehicle_id, make, model, component_id, injury_count, death_count, summary_text]) -> FILTER(make='NISSAN' AND model='ALTIMA' AND component_id='AIRBAG' AND (injury_count > 0 OR death_count > 0)) -> SEM_FILTER('summary_text describes an airbag inflator rupture, airbag explosion, shrapnel, or metal fragments causing injury or possible serious injury.', input_bindings={text: summary_text}) -> SEM_EXTRACT('Extract the primary airbag failure mode as a short canonical phrase.', out_schema={airbag_failure_mode: string}, input_bindings={text: summary_text}) -> JOIN(inner, on=[vehicle_id], right=( SCAN_DOCS(NHTSA, recalls, [campaign.number, vehicle.vehicle_id AS vehicle_id, component.component_id]) -> FILTER(component.component_id='AIRBAG') -> DEDUP([vehicle_id, campaign.number]) )) -> PROJECT([complaint_id, vehicle_id, campaign_number: campaign.number, airbag_failure_mode])

SCAN_TABLE(NHTSA, complaints, [model_year, component_id, vehicle_towed_flag, injury_count, summary_text]) -> FILTER(model_year IN [2024,2025]) -> SEM_FILTER('summary_text describes a tangible safety event, not only a paperwork issue, recall notice, cosmetic concern, or routine service request.', input_bindings={text: summary_text}) -> SEM_EXTRACT('Extract a short canonical failure_mode label from the complaint summary.', out_schema={failure_mode: string}, input_bindings={text: summary_text}) -> GROUP_BY([component_id], aggs={complaint_count: count(*), towed_rate: avg(vehicle_towed_flag='true'), avg_injury: avg(injury_count), dominant_failure_mode: mode_with_tiebreak(failure_mode, tiebreak='alpha_asc')}) -> PROJECT([component_id, complaint_count, towed_rate, avg_injury, dominant_failure_mode])
